summary.text: Joe White is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 40 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a U.S. Air Force veteran and former chief executive of a medical products company.

paragraphs.text: Joe White was born in Rockwood, Tennessee, and lives in Prosperity, South Carolina.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1966 to 1969, earned a B.S. in public administration, and worked as CEO of Medical Comfort Systems, Inc.
White assumed office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Richard Martin, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he believes all legislation should be decided by how it affects the rights to life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness.
He listed improving law enforcement and the judicial system, improving education, and decreasing the tax burden on working families as his key campaign messages.
